title: Weights & Biases (W&B) — What it is
description: Weights & Biases is the hosted dashboard where ML experiments go to be compared: wandb.init() starts a run, wandb.log() streams loss curves and metrics live, and the web UI turns hundreds of runs into sortable leaderboards. Sweeps automate hyperparameter search; Artifacts version datasets and models with lineage. Founded 2017 in San Francisco, it is the industry default for keeping training organized. It is made by Weights & Biases (acquired by CoreWeave 2025) and runs on Windows, macOS, Linux (Python).
